title: Expectation & Variance of a Function of X

titles.leaf: Expectation & Variance of a Function of X

author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: Use, when solving problems, the results that $\text{E}(aX + b) = a\text{E}(X) + b$ and $\text{Var}(aX + b) = a^{2} \text{Var}(X)$
Use, when solving problems, the results that $\text{E}(aX + bY) = a\text{E}(X) + b\text{E}(Y)$
Use, when solving problems, the results that $\text{Var}(aX + bY) = a^{2}\text{Var}(X) + b^{2}\text{Var}(Y)$ for independent $X$ and $Y$
Use, when solving problems, the results that if $X$ has a normal distribution then so does $aX + b$
Use, when solving problems, the results that if $X$ and $Y$ have independent normal distributions then $aX + bY$ has a normal distribution
Use, when solving problems, the results that if $X$ and $Y$ have independent Poisson distributions then $X + Y$ has a Poisson distribution.
